meta.description: Performs DESeq2 bulk RNA-seq differential expression with Wald/LRT tests, LFC shrinkage, filtering, transformations, and paired, batch, and interaction designs.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numerical claims in the evaluated outputs were printed by the saved runs; no fabricated research result was found.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill analyzes count matrices and makes no individual diagnosis, treatment, or clinical recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: The tested advice correctly rejected cell-level replication, bare results() in multi-factor designs, and post-hoc shrunken-LFC FDR claims.

code_usability.detail: Every R route that reached a validated result exited 139 (segmentation fault). A minimal saved library(DESeq2) smoke test reproduced the fault after printing PASS, isolating it to the declared shared R environment rather than a particular Skill block.

functional_suitability.note: The decision tree and references cover the advertised designs and corrections; the frontmatter still does not name pseudobulk although the decision tree supports it.

reliability.note: Specific failure modes and remedies are strong; the current declared runtime cannot exit cleanly after DESeq2 use.

performance_context.note: The focused SKILL.md delegates method detail to eleven selectable references.

agent_usability.note: Explicit contrasts, reference-level warnings, and decision routing are clear; reporting fields are not specified in source despite the checkpoint claim.

human_usability.note: Natural bulk-DE triggers are clear, but a researcher asking specifically for pseudobulk DE may not trigger the bulk-worded description.

security.note: No credentials, destructive commands, or raw-code execution are present; count/metadata alignment is described but not validated by a reusable guard.

maintainability.note: Reference separation is clean and every referenced file exists; examples have no small fixture or expected-result check.

agent_specific.note: Progressive disclosure and clear escape hatches are strong; pseudobulk trigger precision and a contrast-support stop condition remain incomplete.

key_strengths: Explicit contrast and reference-level guidance prevented the high-impact bare-results trap in live runs.
The pseudobulk boundary was verified with a constructed null contrast and known truth.
Reference files cleanly separate LRT, interaction, tximport, filtering, shrinkage, and transform detail.
All source claims tested before the runtime shutdown fault matched observed output.

recommendations.title: Repair the declared DESeq2 R runtime
recommendations.problem: The declared R 4.4.3 environment exits 139 after DESeq2 use, including after a minimal library(DESeq2) smoke test prints PASS.
recommendations.root_cause: The failure reproduces without a Skill-specific analysis block, so it is a shared runtime/package-build fault rather than a source defect.
recommendations.fix: The environment owner must repair or rebuild the single-cell-transcriptomics-analyst R runtime, then rerun the saved Phase 2 scripts. Do not publish from this failing declared environment.

recommendations.title: Correct the final-pass checkpoint record
recommendations.problem: CHECKPOINT.md says the frontmatter gained a pseudobulk trigger and a what-to-report section, but neither exists at e70064331a8091df08a09ebee3368302bc0f622e.
recommendations.root_cause: The checkpoint records intended or earlier changes that are absent from the pinned source.
recommendations.fix: Reconcile CHECKPOINT.md with the pinned commit before a future fix pass; either add the documented source changes or remove the unsupported completion claim.

recommendations.title: Make pseudobulk a frontmatter trigger
recommendations.problem: The decision tree supports donor-level pseudobulk correctly, but the description remains bulk-worded and may not trigger for a pseudobulk request.
recommendations.root_cause: The capability is only discoverable after the Skill has already been loaded.
recommendations.fix: Add single-cell pseudobulk DE aggregated by biological sample to the description.

recommendations.title: State the minimum reporting fields
recommendations.problem: Source does not direct an agent to report contrast, alpha, filtering threshold, sample counts, NA causes, and LFC source.
recommendations.root_cause: The claimed reporting addition is absent from SKILL.md.
recommendations.fix: Add a compact what-to-report section matching the checkpoint's stated fields.
